_comment: UNMEASURED model variant; not a submitted job or spend authorization. Matched 800-step successor to the first RWKV7 M2 cache-fork cell. See plans/codex/RWKV7_FORK_EVIDENCE.md.
head: fork_evidence

heldout_excluded.reason: train.heldout (D1-B, k=8) finds the 4-word fragment 'rather than relying on' of template soft_framing in these three MMLU aux_train records (natural text, no injection; the PR #44 build guard, word 6-grams, does not fire). Excluded from the draw, fail-closed: the heldout phase passes only if the full-set hits are exactly these ids (2026-10-06 local scan, 150,000 texts, 112 s).

execution_note: Same chunked_lean WKV, block checkpointing and 8-row/8192-token grouping as the fork parent. This head also reads existing prefix features; its head runtime and peak memory have not been measured. Qualify before a capped training experiment.
max_minutes_note: training wall-clock inside the 230-min cell phase: 230 - load/draw/tokenize ~10 - smoke+ladder ~10 - two dev cards ~10 - checkpoints/margin 10 = 190 (pre-registered); cumulative over restarts (train_clock in cell.json)
min_steps_note: exit 26 if the measured step time cannot reach 600 optimiser steps (4,800 rows) inside max_minutes: below that the cell is not a meaningful first measurement; re-price instead of spending the evals
lora_rank_note: M2_RUN_SPEC r=256 adds ~1.15B trainable params (~18 GB of fp32 weights + grads + Adam) on top of 26.5 GB bf16 weights and the un-checkpointed cache-fork activations; r=64 (the pilot's pre-registered rank) keeps the T=2048 ladder rung inside the 76 GB stop
